subject: Inbound demo request — HealthSync (self-serve signup)
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@healthsync.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request — evaluating Redwood for clinical note generation

Hi Marissa,

We just completed a trial on the self-serve API and liked the initial latency and cost numbers. I'm Emily, Head of AI at HealthSync. We're evaluating options to replace our current generation stack for clinical note synthesis across several products. Before we book a demo we'd love to get a quick sense of whether Redwood fits our constraints:

- Primary use case: structured clinical note generation from encounter transcripts (radiology and primary care).
- Expected Q1 volume: ~200k tokens/day projected ramping to ~1M tokens/day in 6 months.
- Latency requirement: p95 generation under 800ms for short notes (<=512 tokens) and acceptable batching for longer summaries.
- Timeline: pilot in April, production by Q3 if evaluation goes well.

Could you share who on your team would lead the demo (tech + procurement), what a typical 30min demo agenda looks like, and a few available times next week? Attaching our internal requirements doc for context.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Head of AI, HealthSync
emily.zhang@healthsync.io
S: (415) 555-0142

Attachment: SaaS-Requirements-HealthSync.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@healthsync.io>
Date: 2026-03-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — evaluating Redwood for clinical note generation

Hi Emily — great to meet you and thanks for the context + attachment. I'm on the Redwood commercial SDR/AE team and can coordinate the initial session. Quick Qs so we can tailor the demo: 

1) Which models / fidelity are you most interested in (highest quality or cost-optimized variants)?
2) Do your transcripts include PHI that requires specific residency / encryption controls?
3) Do you expect steady traffic or large daily bursts?
4) Who needs to be on the call from your side (engineering, procurement, security)?

Typical 30-min demo agenda we run: 1) brief intros + goals (5m), 2) product walkthrough (inference API, streaming, batching) and performance numbers (10m), 3) security/compliance and deployment modes (5m), 4) Q&A and next steps (10m).

I can run the demo and loop in Rishi (solutions) for the technical deep-dive. Here are a few slots next week (PT):
- Tue 2026-03-23 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-03-24 14:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-03-25 09:00–09:30

Or you can book directly: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

If you can reply with answers to the questions above and who will attend, I'll send the invite and a short mutual action plan.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@healthsync.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@healthsync.io>
Date: 2026-03-19T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — evaluating Redwood for clinical note generation

Thanks Marissa — answers below: 

1) We're primarily focused on highest quality for now (clinical accuracy is critical). Cost-optimized variants are interesting for longer-run adoption but quality-first for pilot.
2) Yes — transcripts contain PHI. We require SOC 2 evidence and prefer US residency for now.
3) Expecting steady daily traffic with weekly peak windows post-batch ingest; we can provide expected daily distribution if helpful.
4) Likely attendees: myself (Head of AI), Andrew Bates (Head of Engineering — cc'd), and possibly one security engineer for the compliance segment.

Preferred slot: Wed 2026-03-24 14:00 PT works for us.

Attaching a short company overview.

Best,
Emily

Attachment: HealthSync-Overview.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

- 0–5m: intros + success criteria
- 5–15m: demo — streaming generation, prompt engineering for templates, and p95 latency on short notes
- 15–22m: compliance & deployment options (SOC 2, KMS, residency)
- 22–30m: rollout path & next steps (pilot scope, timelines, pricing)

I'll bring a few sample perf runs and cost estimates based on the volumes you provided. Marissa — can you send a calendar invite with Google Meet?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra

rishi@redwood.com
